structured_output.summary: The change implements setUTCHours step by step with the right ordering. The this-check comes first. ToNumber runs on hour, then minute, second and millisecond, each only if present, and every error propagates with `?`. The NaN check on tv comes after the conversions. Missing arguments fall back to the time-component helpers. The result goes through MakeDate, MakeTime and TimeClip, is stored on the object and returned. An explicit `undefined` argument counts as present because the code checks `args.get(i)`, which matches the spec. It reuses the shared `support::date` helpers instead of re-implementing them. The target went from 8 to 22 passing with no regressions. I found no special-casing, swallowed errors or unrelated edits. The only cosmetic change is that the trailing spec comments about `length` and the NOTE were dropped, which is harmless.
